buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up

Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address Manager (OS) LIC of India, Delhi DO-3 UG Floor, Jeevan Pravah Building, District Centre-Janakpuri New Delhi-110058 . 3. Generic Buyer Organization specific Integrity Pact shall have to be complied by all bidders. Bidders shall have to upload scanned copy of signed integrity pact as per Buyer organizations policy along with bid. Click here to view the file 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of LIC of India payable at New Delhi . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Banker’s Cheque in favour of LIC of India payable at New Delhi . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the BC along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of LIC of India payable at New Delhi . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1) The bid is for procurement of different type of folders (Printed pages shaped in folder/booklet and staple d) /forms having different no. of pages of same size. Attached sample is one of such folder/form.

2)Rates are to be quoted by the bidder for single page {1 copy or 1 sheet of paper having finished size of 21.6 cm x 27.9 cm (8.5x11 inches) will be counted as 2 pages }. Different folders/forms may have different number of pages but sheet of same size. For example, if a prop osal form is having 16 pages, then it will be printed on 8 sheets of size 21.6 cm x 27.9 cm (8.5x11 inches) with both side printing and centrally stitched /stapled. Quoted rates shall also include pri ce for stitching/stapling. 3) The above mentioned pre-printed stationery will be procured under HSN code 4820 and the prevailing GST rate for these pre-printed forms in fold er/booklet shape is 18% with HSN 4820. Bidders are advised to keep in mind the said applicable GST rate before quoting the all-inclusive rate s. The invoices with correct applicable GST will only be accepted at the time of supply of the r equired item. 4) Quoted rates shall be valid for a period of 1 year with further increase in contract duration if required, at the sole discretion of the competent authority, as per option clause. The quantity will be procured in a staggered manner and multiple purchase orders shall be issued during the currency of the con tract as per our requirement with a provision of 25% increase or decrease in the tendered quantity. 5) Printing material for each folder/form will be different and artwork shall be provided to the successful bi dder after award of contract. Supply should be made within 30 days of placing the order through e-mail during the currency of the contract. However, an extra period of maximum 7 days will be give n on vendor’s part {Includes submission of soft copy of artwork for proof reading/making, further correctio ns and re-submission, if required} to get the artwork approved, failing which penalty will be imposed as pe r GeM GTC/SLA. 6) Print line with Vendor’s name /Bid No/MMYY/Qty will be required to be printed on all folders/forms. 7) In case of GSM found below the mentioned acceptable range, proportionate recovery or rejection of item s shall be decided at the sole discretion of the Competent Authority depending upon merits of each case. 8) The successful bidder shall arrange the supply of ordered quantity at his cost to our Store addressed at: LIC of India, Delhi Divisional Office -3 Upper Ground Floor, “Jeevan Pravah Building” District Centre-Janakpuri, New Delhi-110058 9) “In terms of provisions of Section 33(3) and 33(4) of The Insurance Laws (Amendment) Act, 2015, Insura nce Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI),if it considers expedient to do so, may direct a ny person hereinafter referred to as “Investigating Officer”, to make an investigation as specified under Se c.33(1) or carry out an inspection as specified under Section 33(2) of the Insurance Laws (Amendment) Act ,2015, who may examine on oath any Manager, Managing Director or other Officer of the service provider or contractor where the services are outsourced by LIC of India.” .
